acceptanceCriteria: Recognizably belongs to the Burrowers family and preserves every identity invariant.
Reads specifically as Hookjaw Burrower, T3, rather than another family form.
Communicates the Drag-Under Specialist archetype and its battlefield duty.
Preserves coherent load-bearing anatomy, complete limbs, and believable ground contact.
Uses at least two earth construction dimensions without a palette-only or glow-only treatment.
Keeps the attack telegraph and counterplay signal visible at gameplay scale.
Frames one complete featured subject with no crop, labels, UI text, or watermark.
Output remains a candidate until independent approved-review evidence exists; it is never a runtime asset.
anatomyInvariants: Split hook mandibles, flattened head shield, muscular collar rings, and a narrower towing body with high lateral flexibility.
Signature mechanic: Converging Hooks: two jaw tips travel under separate cracks, surface around the target, and retract toward the same tunnel mouth.
battlefieldDuty: Catch a target or terrain anchor between split jaws and tow it sideways toward a tunnel.
constructionDimensions: Compressed mineral caps reinforce selected front rings, jaws, and tail tools while flexible tissue remains visible between plates.
Detached stones and sediment layers move with the true body route, making subterranean mass readable.
counterplay: Break either convergence line or strike the exposed jaw hinge before the hooks close. Affinity signal: A pale fracture opens at the jaw hinge, rear plate, or feeding collar after the loaded segment moves.
forbiddenTreatments: Solid rock worm without flexible segments
Random stones unrelated to tunnel displacement
identityInvariants: Every form retains a limbless segmented body, armored digging front, softer articulated rear, tactile sensory organs, and soil-displacing locomotion.
Tier is shown through mandible specialization, segment reinforcement, collar structure, tail shape, and tunneling behavior rather than humanoid traits.
The real underground route and the exposed punish segment always have physical environmental tells.
telegraph: Paired ground cracks converge while both hooked jaw tips briefly break the surface.
